messages.content: Westgate Family Dentistry: Hazel Marsh has a cleaning and checkup Wed 11/25 at 10:40 AM. Reply C to confirm or call us to reschedule.
C
Thank you! Hazel's appointment is confirmed. Please arrive 10 min early if any insurance info has changed.
Actually quick question. Can I text a photo of her insurance card or do I need to bring it in?
this is the front desk. A photo works, front and back please. We'll update the file before her visit.
Sent both sides just now. Also she's been saying a back tooth feels sensitive with cold stuff, can the dentist take a look?
Got the card, all set. I added a note about the cold sensitivity so Dr. Patel checks that tooth and may take an x-ray.
Perfect, thank you. See you on the 25th.
WebstaurantStore: Your order #8841207 has shipped! 2 of 3 boxes are on the way via FedEx Ground. Track: webst.co/t/8841207
Which item is in the third box? I really need the parchment sheets before next Saturday
the third box is the 18x26 half-sheet pans (qty 12). Parchment sheets (1,000 ct) are in box 1, arriving Thursday.
Ok good, the parchment is the urgent one. When do the pans ship?
They're shipping from a different warehouse. Expected to leave tomorrow, with delivery estimated next Tuesday.
That works. Can you make sure that box gets the delivery note to use the back door? Front is locked till 6am
Done, I added "Deliver to rear entrance" to the remaining shipment. Anything else I can help with?
Nope that's it, appreciate it
Spectrum: We've detected a service interruption in your area. Our technicians are working to restore it. Est. restore time 4:30 PM.
It's 6 now and still down. Modem has a blinking blue light
Sorry for the trouble, Elena. The area outage was cleared at 5:10 PM. Can you unplug the modem for 60 seconds and plug it back in?
Did that twice. Still blinking blue, no wifi. I have bookkeeping to do tonight.
I'm sending a refresh signal to your modem now. It may take up to 5 minutes for the lights to turn solid.
Solid white now and wifi is back. Thank you
Glad it's working! A $6.40 credit for the outage will show on your next statement.
Spectrum: Your technician appointment for equipment check is scheduled Sat 10/17 between 8-10 AM. Reply 1 to confirm, 2 to cancel.
2, it's been fine since the reset, don't need it
Your appointment has been canceled. If issues come back, text us anytime.
Hey is this Robin? Sarah gave me your number for the dog walking
Hi, sorry, no, this isn't Robin. I think you got the wrong number
Oh no, sorry about that. She wrote it on a napkin so maybe I misread a digit
No worries, happens. Could be a 7 instead of a 1 or something
Ha that's probably it. Her handwriting is rough. I'll text her and double check
Good luck finding Robin!
Found her, it was a 4 not a 0. Sorry again for bugging you on a Sunday
Not a bother at all. Hope the pup likes her
Thanks, you're nice. Have a good one
You too!
Biscuit Head: You're on the waitlist for 2! Current wait is about 35 min. We'll text when your table is ready.
Thanks. Can we get a table outside if one opens up?
Noted for patio seating. That might add 10 min or so, we'll keep you posted.
That's fine, we're walking around the block
Your patio table for 2 is ready! Please check in with the host within 10 minutes.
On our way, 3 min out
Biscuit Head: Your to-go order for Elena is confirmed. 1 biscuit box (6) with jam bar sampler. Ready at 9:15 AM.
Can you swap one of the jams for honey butter? My kid only eats that one
Sure thing, swapped one jam for honey butter. See you at 9:15!
Great, thanks!
Anyone else lose a recycling bin in that wind last night? Blue lid, 210 painted on the side
Saw one in the ditch by the stop sign on Westwood. I'll drag it back up
Bless you Kevin
Got it back up by the garage. I'm putting a brick on that lid from now on
Block party is Sat 8/22 at 4pm, Walt is bringing the smoker again. Sign up sheet on my porch
Brisket and two pork shoulders. Somebody else handle the sides please
I'll bring two loaves and a tray of cookies.
yesss Elena's bread 🙌
Heads up, the city is repaving Westwood starting Thu 10/1. No street parking 7am to 5pm
Hi Dale, this is Elena Marsh at 214 Westwood Pl. The office said you're doing my gutters and the porch step tomorrow at 8?
Yes ma'am, that's me. I'll text when I'm on the way.
Great. I'm at the bakery all morning, so I won't be home. Side gate on the left is unlatched.
No problem. Any dogs?
Nope, no pets. The side gate sticks a little, just lift it as you push.
Morning. On the way, about 20 minutes out.
Here and set up. Got the gate to cooperate.
Back gutter was packed solid and the corner downspout was clogged. All flushed now.
New tread is in, primed and painted. Keep off it 24 hours while the paint cures.
All done. The office will email the receipt.
Thank you Dale! I'll use the back door until tomorrow.
Sounds good. Have a good one.
Desmond, the grouphead on the left side is dripping again even with the lever off. Pressure's dropping mid shot too.
Ugh. Sounds like the gasket and maybe the solenoid valve. Is the right group pulling normal?
Right side is fine. We're limping along on one group but the Saturday line is going to be rough.
I'm booked through the weekend, but I can do Tuesday at 9 while you're closed. Gaskets and screens on both groups, and I'll descale while it's open. Email scheduling so it's on the books?
Tuesday at 9 is perfect. How long will it be down?
Plan on 90 min for the whole machine. Leave it on and up to temp so I can check brew pressure before I open it up.
Will do. I'll be in from 8:30, back door off the side lot. I'll email scheduling first thing Monday.
Done. Wasn't the solenoid, the left gasket was cracked. New gaskets and screens on both groups, and I descaled the boiler while I had it open, lot of buildup. Pressure's set at 9 bar.
Pulling shots now, crema looks way better. Our water here is brutal.
Want me to quote you on a softener filter for the line? It'd save you a call like this every few months.
Yes please. Email it over when you have numbers.
Will do. Enjoy the Saturday rush.
Hi! Bea from Sourwood. We've got 11 signed up for your sourdough basics class on the 11th. Capping at 12?
12 is the max, I only have enough bannetons for 12. That's a great turnout!
Bread classes always fill. Do you need anything from us besides the flour order and the kitchen?
Could you have 12 quart deli containers and painter's tape for labeling? I'll bring the starter in my own jars.
Easy. Ovens in kitchen 2 are the big decks, so you'll have plenty of room to bake everything at once.
Oh nice. Can I get in at 8:30 to feed the starter and set up? Class is 10.
I'll be there at 8 opening up anyway. Side door by the loading dock.
Last spot just filled! Also one guy emailed asking if he can make it gluten free. What should I tell him?
Honestly not with this recipe. Tell him he's welcome to watch and take the starter home, but GF sourdough is a whole different class.
Ha, maybe that's your next class. I'll let him know.
Maybe! See you at 8:30 on the 11th.
See you then. Coffee will be on.
Anyone have a spare steam tube for a Bongard deck? Mine cracked and the part is 3 weeks out
Not a Bongard but call Smoky Mtn Refrigeration, they fabricated one for me last spring
lifesaver
Butter is up again at Restaurant Depot, $4.19 a lb. Anyone buying direct from a dairy?
French Broad Dairy. Weekly delivery, two case minimum.
thank you!!
Hiring a morning baker if anyone knows someone good, 4 days a week starting October
👍 will pass it on
Anyone buying from Piedmont Grain out of Salisbury? Thinking about trying their rye and whole wheat
Not us. We've bought from the same mill since 2022. Tell me how their rye is if you try it.
Pie season. Who's doing Thanksgiving preorders this year and what are you charging for pecan
$34 for pecan, $28 apple. Cutoff is 11/20 for us
Craggy Gardens tomorrow at 4? Rhododendrons should be peaking this week
in
I can do 4. Meet at the visitor center lot.
I have a country loaf left from the market. I'll bring it.
bringing cheese then
Bent Creek tmrw? Supposed to storm after 5 so maybe start at 3:30
cant this week, kid has a soccer tournament in Hendersonville
Good luck at the tournament. I'm in, coming straight from the café.
When does the market wrap up this year? Want to grab a few more loaves before it does
The Saturday before Thanksgiving. Come early, the rye goes first.
Anyone up for Craggy for the leaves? Thinking the 18th or the 25th
Either works for me. Has to be after the café closes.
Hi! Is the fall wildflower harvest out yet? I want to do honey oat loaves for the next month.
Just finished jarring it Sunday! It's darker than last year, lots of goldenrod. Really good though.
Ooh goldenrod is perfect for bread. Could I get two of the 5 gallon pails?
I can do one pail now and another in two weeks. We're a little short, the dry August hurt us.
One now is plenty to start. Could I also get a case of the little 8oz jars to sell at the counter?
Sure. 24 in a case. I'll put the shelf tags in so people know it's local.
Customers ask about it all the time. When can you drop off?
Friday morning work? I'll be in town for the market around 7.
7 is great, I'll be up to my elbows in dough. Just come to the back door.
Dropped off! Your guy at the back helped me carry the pail in. Invoice is taped on the lid.
Got it, thank you! Saving you a honey oat loaf for next time you come by.
Deal. I'll hold you to that.

Great, see you around 2:15

NO

Probably the supply line. I'll have Dale stop by Thursday too since the crew will be there. Ok if he comes in while you're open?
Yes that's fine. Have him use the back door and Luis will show him the sink. We close at 3, so ideally before then
Got it, I'll tell him to be done by 3. Thanks Elena.
